CustomField.description: Formula to display months remaining in years and months format
CustomField.formula: TEXT(FLOOR( Months_Remaining__c /12)) & ' Years' & ' ' & IF(FLOOR(MOD(Months_Remaining__c,12)) = 0, '', TEXT(FLOOR(MOD(Months_Remaining__c,12))) & IF(FLOOR(MOD(Months_Remaining__c,12)) = 1, ' Month ', ' Months '))
CustomField.label: Remaining Term
